author: BabanBanana
quote: This time around Rockstar really made the effort to not offend anyone; one of the aspects that made a GTA game gone. The critic reviews are rigged because they're too scared to be on Rockstars bad side; doesn't deserve the 99 it got. Can't hold a steady 30fps and riddled with game breaking bugs. These people really think shipping an unfinished game is okay in this day and age; ship now fix later mentally is what's wrong with the games industry. We waited 13 years for a GTA 5.5 slop that's been watered down with some kind of woke agenda. GTA fanboys are completely delusional right now. Overall a complete letdown. Most overhyped game of the decade. They review bombed Ocarina of Time because they're upset this game doesn't live up to anyone's expectations.
